g.text: the 1300 / 550 / 2000 nm values are the book's own thresholds (file.md 2307).

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 9.4px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: (b) Error in effective index; log scale

text.style: font-size: 6.3px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #a1a1a6

g.text: error = |n_eff(span) - n_eff(2000 nm)| for each mode (the book's definition).

text.style: font-size: 6.3px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #a1a1a6

g.text: the curves stop at 1900 nm: the 2000 nm result IS the reference, so its error is 0 by definition.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: 4 · Why TM needs more room: the 10⁻⁶ tail-decay rule

text.style: font-size: 7.2px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: end; fill: #a1a1a6
font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: Takeaway: size the domain to the mode's tail — 1300 nm for TE, 2000 nm for TM — and verify it with the error curve, not by eye.

text.style: font-size: 6.6px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #a1a1a6

g.text: Source: book Section 3.2.4 (Convergence tests), file.md lines 2300-2336; the span sweep is Script 3.7 (Listing 3.7, file.md lines 3684-3701, zspan 400-2000 nm).

text.style: font-size: 6.6px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #a1a1a6

g.text: Curves are computed here, not redrawn: 1D slab (1550 nm, 220 nm Si n = 3.473 in SiO2 n = 1.444), linear FEM, mesh anchored at the slab centre and held at dz = 10 nm.

text.style: font-size: 6.6px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #a1a1a6

g.text: Converged: TE 2.8443 (book 2.845), TM 2.0498 (book 2.054/2.051); finer meshes shift these by < 1e-3. Panel 4: Eq. 3.3 tails with the book's effective indices.

text.style: font-size: 6.6px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #a1a1a6

g.text: Panel 1 is a schematic cross-section — not a simulation; the mesh is drawn magnified (the 10 nm pitch is ~0.5% of the span).
